register.labelZh: WALK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: walk away、walk off 和 walk out 可以表達不同的離開原因和方式。；walk off with a prize 表示輕易得獎;walk off with somebody’s phone 則表示未經許可拿走別人的電話。；你可以分辨撞上門、跌入圈套,以及走近某人等不同情況。；你可以用 walk through a scene 表示簡單排練,也可以用 walk somebody through a process 表示逐步講解流程。
register.summaryEn: movement Walk away, walk off and walk out express different reasons and ways of leaving. Walk off with a prize means winning it easily, but walk off with somebody’s phone means taking it without permission. You can distinguish walking into a door, walking into a trap and walking up to a person. You can walk through a scene during a simple rehearsal or walk somebody through a process by explaining each stage.
contextsZh: WALK 不只描述步行,也能描述選擇和反應
理解相同字詞所表達的不同意思
準確描述移動、失誤和危險
自然描述排練和逐步指導
contextsEn: Use WALK to describe choices and reactions, not only physical
Understand identical words with very different meanings
Talk precisely about movement, mistakes and danger
Explain practice and step-by-step guidance naturally

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；walk off with something 可以表示輕易贏得某物,也可以表示未經許可拿走某物。請仔細閱讀整個情境。；from 和 to 只在句子需要時才加入。比較:walk away / walk away from the problem;walkup / walk up to the desk。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Walk off with something can mean winning something easily or taking something without permission. Read the full situation carefully. Words such as from and to are added only when the sentence needs them. Compare: walk away / walk away from the problem; walk up / walk up to the desk.
